# Respiratory Risk Report


### Week Ending in September 26, 2026


[Marisa Donnelly, PhD](https://substack.com/@marisadonnelly)


Oct 02, 2026


Biobot’s national wastewater network suggests the summer Covid wave may have finally peaked. After several weeks of rising activity, the amount of virus in wastewater is now declining. Covid levels remain fairly elevated in the West, but across the country, every region is either trending down or has leveled off.


Other respiratory viruses are still circulating at very low levels, but we’re starting to see the first hints of the fall and winter season. RSV is creeping up in the South, while flu A is beginning to rise in the West. HMPV and flu B remain quiet for now.


**Bottom line**


Covid looks like it’s easing, but we’re starting to see the seasonal respiratory virus handoff. Winter virus season isn’t quite here yet, but it’s getting closer.


With respiratory virus season around the corner, now is a good time to think about getting your fall shots (or at least scheduling them). Which vaccines are recommended depends on your age, health history, and risk factors, so check with your healthcare provider. Most are also available at pharmacies.


---


### **National Outlook**


#### **COVID-19**


Nationally, SARS-CoV-2 is decreasing.


#### **Influenza**


Nationally, influenza A is slightly increasing but remains low, while influenza B is holding steady at very low levels.


#### **RSV**


Nationally, RSV is slightly increasing but remains low.


#### **HMPV**


Nationally, HMPV is decreasing.


---
